newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 25.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:
* Ex-Republican Chairman Haley Barbour rebutted Democratic assertions that the GOP accepted illegal foreign contributions.
* Justice William Brennan died, seven years after his retirement from the Supreme Court.
* In the days before he shot himself, murder suspect Andrew Cunanan desperately tried to get a fake passport so he could escape.
* The names on the list of 1,756 dormant accounts issued by Swiss banks on Wednesday included as many non-Jews as Jews.
* Eleven years after raping a 16-year-old neighbor in the back of a friend's car in the wealthy suburb of Darien, Conn., Alex Kelly went to prison to begin a 16-year term.

* A Dallas jury awarded nearly $120 million in damages after finding that the local Roman Catholic Diocese had ignored evidence that a priest was sexually abusing boys and that it tried to cover up the scandal.
